fee_notes: Fee varies by franchisee experience level: new franchisees pay $10,500, intermediate franchisees pay $3,195, and experienced franchisees pay $495. Discounts available: 30% for U.S. military veterans or immediate family members of active service members, 10% under the Diversity Fran initiative, and 20% under the Community Heroes discount (first responders, teachers, healthcare workers, exemplary community volunteers). Franchisor may finance the fee for qualified new franchisees (minimum $3,500 down payment required). Franchisor may also periodically offer rebates or additional discounts. All fees are nonrefundable. A separate training fee of $495 applies for replacement managers and sales associates.
raw_excerpt: If you are a new franchisee, your Initial Franchise Fee is $10,500. • If you are an intermediate franchisee, your Initial Franchise Fee is $3,195. • If you are an experienced franchisee, your Initial Franchise Fee is $495.
